page.content:
Critic whose 100-point scores reshaped late-century fine-wine markets.

How Robert Parker connects

  • Topic: Tasting-note culture — Parker's scores and paragraphs trained late-century tasting-note culture.
  • Location: Bordeaux — Parker's Wine Advocate scores moved the Bordeaux market in particular.

What is Robert Parker?

Robert M. Parker Jr.'s Wine Advocate scores moved prices, especially in Bordeaux, and trained a generation to read wine as a number plus a paragraph.

Key threads lead to Tasting-note culture and Bordeaux.
